verdict.rationale: Elicit ships a built-in Research Agent. Users can delegate work to it in natural language: adding extraction columns, filtering and exporting sources, generating figures and drafting slides. Delegation is tunable through effort levels and reusable skills, and works in shared sessions. Community reports about summary accuracy concern output quality, not whether delegation works, so they do not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the current Research Agent specifically (the one community report covers the older topic analysis feature), and evidence on the reliability of agent-produced outputs.
